card.name: Inside species epithets named after people
card.fires_on: Partway through a Latin species name whose ending honors a person, just before the -ii or -i ending, as in thiersii, higginsii or pringlei. Also seen in some ecology and biology terms such as biotic.

modes.label: Eponym species names
modes.description: The middle of a Latin species epithet built from a surname, just before the ending -ii, -i or -iana.

modes.label: Ecology terms
modes.description: Parts of ecology words or phrases in habitat and conservation text, such as biotic or soft bottom.

card.writes: Little coherent effect; the promoted tokens are mixed Chinese and English words about dust, heat dissipation and living things, and the suppressed ones are about wastewater and pollution.
